summary.ja: 1電子の問題から離散化と固有値・固有関数の誤差を調べる。
summary.en: Start with one-electron discretization, eigenvalues and eigenfunctions.

references.label: Schrödinger, E. (1926), Quantisierung als Eigenwertproblem
references.scope: Primary publication entry point for the quantum-chemistry overview. Bibliographic/introductory review only; full-paper equations and numerical results have not been reproduced.

references.label: Roothaan, C. C. J. (1951), New Developments in Molecular Orbital Theory
references.scope: Primary publication entry point for the quantum-chemistry overview. Bibliographic/introductory review only; full-paper equations and numerical results have not been reproduced.

assumptions: Nonrelativistic isolated atom; infinite-mass point nucleus.
Reduced radial orbitals on a second-order uniform finite-difference grid.
He is restricted to a closed-shell spherical 1s² state; both HF and LDA_X omit correlation.
units: Atomic units in the displayed electronic equations (hbar = m_e = e = 4 pi epsilon_0 = 1); dimensionless conventions are stated where needed.
boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(r_max)=0; hydrogenic r_max=60 bohr, He r_max=16 bohr, with separate domain studies.

next_deliverable.ja: 調和振動子・水素型原子で領域と格子の誤差を分離。
next_deliverable.en: Separate domain and resolution errors for oscillator and hydrogenic models.

limitations.ja: 孤立水素型原子の1s・2s・2p・3dを一様動径格子で検証。多電子Schrödinger方程式全体の直接解法ではありません。
limitations.en: Uniform radial-grid tests of isolated hydrogenic 1s, 2s, 2p and 3d states; not a direct general many-electron Schrödinger solver.

metadata_review.level: scoped radial educational implementation; analytic and independently computed PySCF reference checks; see separate quantum-atoms code edition

assumptions_ja: 非相対論・孤立原子・無限質量の点核。
一様動径格子と2次中心差分による縮約動径軌道。
Heは閉殻・球対称1s²に限定し、HFとLDA_Xともに相関を含まない。
units_ja: 表示する電子状態の式は原子単位系（ℏ = m_e = e = 4πε₀ = 1）。無次元量や占有の規約は各節に明記。
boundary_conditions_ja: u(0)=u(r_max)=0。水素型はr_max=60 bohr、Heは16 bohrを基本に領域依存を別途検査。

caution.ja: 核運動、相対論、スピン軌道相互作用、外場はこの代表式に含めません。固有値の残差が小さくても、領域・基底の誤差は残ります。
caution.en: Nuclear dynamics, relativity, spin–orbit coupling and external fields are outside this representative Hamiltonian. A small eigenpair residual does not establish domain or basis convergence.

example_scope.ja: 孤立水素型原子の1s・2s・2p・3dを一様動径格子で検証。多電子Schrödinger方程式全体の直接解法ではありません。
example_scope.en: Uniform radial-grid tests of isolated hydrogenic 1s, 2s, 2p and 3d states; not a direct general many-electron Schrödinger solver.
